answer: Steam rises off the vat in the paper mill, and the moulds hang drying on the line. Proof of papermaker via sheet vat tally — a sheet the papermaker lifts only after 31 sheets dry flat without a tear, each sheet lifted by the papermaker himself. oasis dips the mould and lifts a sheet thin as a moth's wing. onyx couches the sheet onto the felt and presses it flat. delta hangs the finished sheets and counts them before they dry. Faking this proof takes 31 sheets without a single tear, and the thirty-second still splits where the pulp ran thin.
